parts.name: Rebuilt Inline-4

parts.name: 2.5 L Boxer Four

parts.name: Tuned V6
parts.blurb: Ported heads and a freer exhaust.

parts.name: Supercharged V8

parts.name: 650cc Parallel Twin

parts.name: 1.5 L Diesel Triple

parts.name: 2.8 L Turbo Diesel

parts.name: 4.5 L Diesel Six

parts.name: 6.7 L Twin-Turbo Diesel V8
parts.blurb: Pre-war heavy-duty power. Enormous, and it never tires.

parts.name: 50cc Scooter Motor
parts.blurb: Two-stroke wheeze. Gets you to the next ditch.

parts.name: 250cc Quad Single
parts.blurb: A thumping single. Simple and cheerful.

parts.name: 1.0 L Hatchback Triple
parts.blurb: Three small cylinders and a lot of hope.

parts.name: 1.8 L Family Four
parts.blurb: The engine of a thousand school runs.

parts.name: 2.0 L Rally Four
parts.blurb: Carbed, tough, and happy off the road.

parts.name: 2.5 L Pickup Diesel

parts.name: 3.0 L Van Diesel
parts.blurb: Built to haul a ton all day.

parts.name: 6.6 L Truck Diesel
parts.blurb: A proper truck motor.

parts.name: 14.5 L Rig Diesel

parts.name: Scooter Cooling Fins

parts.name: Quad Radiator
parts.blurb: A little side-mounted core.

parts.name: Van Radiator

parts.name: Truck Radiator

parts.blurb: A wall of radiators.

parts.name: No radiator

parts.name: Patched Road Tyre

parts.name: Mud-Terrain Tyre
parts.blurb: Deep lugs that bite into sand and mud.

parts.name: Beadlock Crawler
parts.blurb: A wide bolted rim on a soft sidewall. Goes anywhere.

parts.name: Sheet-Metal Plating
parts.blurb: Roofing tin, riveted over the doors.

parts.name: Welded Plate Kit
parts.blurb: Cut road-sign steel welded into a proper shell.

parts.name: Ceramic Composite Plates
parts.blurb: Pre-war armour tiles. Heavy and very hard to find.

parts.name: Scrap LMG Mount
parts.blurb: A light machine gun on a welded post.

parts.name: Twin LMG Mount
parts.blurb: Two barrels, one trigger.

parts.name: Heavy MG Mount
parts.blurb: A heavy machine gun that chews through armour.

parts.name: Jerry-Can Rack

parts.name: Long-Range Tank
parts.blurb: A second tank plumbed in beside the first.

parts.name: Auxiliary Tank Bank
parts.blurb: Tanks wherever they fit. Long way between pumps.

parts.name: Wire Roof Basket
parts.blurb: A welded wire basket on the roof rails. Small and medium loads stay in it at any speed.

parts.name: Roof Rack & Net
parts.blurb: Rails with a cargo net pulled over the load. Holds medium loads.

parts.name: Steel Cargo Basket
parts.blurb: A deep steel basket with tie-down eyes. Holds big parts too.

parts.name: Expedition Roof Basket
parts.blurb: Full-length basket with a net and ratchet straps. A whole engine rides up there.

parts.name: Rear Carrier Cage
parts.blurb: A wire cage behind the bumper for small loads.

parts.name: Heavy Cargo Cage
parts.blurb: A steel cage on a welded carrier. Holds medium and large loads.

parts.name: Bed Tie-down Kit
parts.blurb: Eyebolts and straps for a pickup or buggy bed. Whatever you strap down stays there.

parts.name: Bed Cargo Net
parts.blurb: A heavy net over the whole bed, tied to every eyebolt.

parts.name: Bull Bar
parts.blurb: Steel tube bumper. Parts zombies and shrugs off knocks.

parts.name: Dozer Blade

parts.name: Spiked Ram
parts.blurb: Welded spikes. Nobody likes being hit by it.

parts.name: Roof Rack
parts.blurb: Rails and two straps for a few small loads. Anything bigger or heavier will not stay put.

parts.name: Light Bar
parts.blurb: A row of spotlights. Night driving becomes possible.

parts.name: Roll Cage
parts.blurb: Tube cage over the cab. Rolls hurt less.

parts.name: Spare Wheel Carrier
parts.blurb: A spare on the back. Flat tyres are a quick swap.

parts.name: Wing Spoiler
parts.blurb: Bolted-on downforce. Mostly for show, a little for grip.

parts.name: Cargo Box
parts.blurb: A lockable box over the tail. Fits a lot of salvage.

parts.name: Rock Sliders
parts.blurb: Steel rails along the sills.

parts.name: Welded Side Plates
parts.blurb: Doors and flanks plated over.

parts.name: Side Pipes
parts.blurb: Open headers. More breath, much more noise.

parts.name: No tyre
parts.blurb: A bare hub and a lot of sparks.

parts.name: No gearbox
parts.blurb: An engine with nothing to turn the wheels.

parts.name: No suspension
parts.blurb: The body rests straight on the axles.

parts.name: No brakes
parts.blurb: Brake lines ending in nothing.

parts.name: No exhaust
parts.blurb: Open ports: loud, and a little freer.

parts.name: No bonnet
parts.blurb: The engine sits in the open air.

parts.name: Cut bonnet
parts.blurb: A hole torn through the panel for an engine that does not fit. It does not grow back.

parts.name: No door
parts.blurb: An open doorway.

parts.name: Standard bonnet
parts.blurb: Pressed steel, with a few dents.

parts.name: Standard door
parts.blurb: A pressed-steel door with a window.

parts.name: Close-Ratio Gearbox
parts.blurb: Short gears: jumps off the line, runs out of top speed early.

parts.name: Overdrive Gearbox
parts.blurb: Tall gears for the long straight. Slow to get going.

parts.name: Heavy-Duty Gearbox
parts.blurb: Truck cogs that shrug off a big engine.

parts.name: Sequential Race Gearbox
parts.blurb: Quick, strong and light. Hard to find.

parts.name: Transfer-Case Gearbox
parts.blurb: Built for something that weighs more than a house.

parts.name: Sport Springs
parts.blurb: Lowered and stiff. Sharp on tarmac, meagre on load.

parts.name: Heavy-Duty Springs
parts.blurb: Leaf packs and bigger dampers. Carries a load.

parts.name: Long-Travel Off-Road Kit
parts.blurb: Tall coilovers that eat dunes.

parts.name: Truck Air-Ride
parts.blurb: Air bags for the big rigs. Hugely strong.

parts.name: Sport Brake Pads
parts.blurb: Grippier pads and braided lines.

parts.name: Big-Bore Discs
parts.blurb: Drilled discs and fat calipers.

parts.name: Race Calipers
parts.blurb: Multi-piston calipers on huge rotors.

parts.name: Truck Air Brakes
parts.blurb: Stops a war rig. Overkill on a hatchback.

parts.name: Free-Flow Exhaust
parts.blurb: Less back-pressure, more noise.

parts.name: Silenced Exhaust
parts.blurb: Stuffed with wool. Whispers where the rest roar.

parts.name: Race Headers
parts.blurb: Long tubes and a straight-through pipe.

parts.name: Straight-Pipe Stacks
parts.blurb: Chrome stacks out of the roof. Everyone knows you are coming.

parts.name: Vented Bonnet
parts.blurb: Louvres let the heat out.

parts.name: Scooped Bonnet
parts.blurb: A big intake scoop. Feeds a blower, cools the bay.

parts.name: Armoured Bonnet
parts.blurb: Plate over the engine. Hot, heavy, safe.

parts.name: Roll-Up Canvas Door
parts.blurb: A flap of tarp. Light, and no use against a bullet.

parts.name: Plated Door
parts.blurb: Sheet steel welded over the skin.

parts.name: Armoured Door
parts.blurb: A thick door with a slit for a window.

parts.name: No seat
parts.blurb: Bare floor mounts and a loose belt buckle. Nobody can ride here; the driver sits on the floor.

parts.name: No rear seat
parts.blurb: Bare floor and bolt brackets. Room for cargo.

parts.name: No steering wheel
parts.blurb: A bare column stub and a loom of wires. The steering barely turns.

parts.name: No dashboard
parts.blurb: A bare cross-beam with the wiring hanging out. The lamps flicker.

parts.name: Factory seat
parts.blurb: Cloth on a spring frame, sagging a little.

parts.name: Factory rear seat
parts.blurb: A cloth bench with a folding back.

parts.name: Factory steering wheel
parts.blurb: A plain plastic rim on a spoked hub.

parts.name: Factory dashboard
parts.blurb: A moulded dash with speedo, temperature and fuel dials.

parts.name: Torn Cloth Seat
parts.blurb: Foam showing through the cloth. Still a seat.

parts.name: Racing Bucket Seat
parts.blurb: Deep bolsters and a harness. Holds a driver in the corners (driver's seat only).

parts.name: Padded Leather Seat
parts.blurb: Thick padding takes the shakes out of rough road (driver's seat only).

parts.name: Plated Seat
parts.blurb: A steel back plate behind the cushion. A little armour, a little weight.

parts.name: Torn Cloth Bench
parts.blurb: Stuffing spilling out of the cushion. A bench is a bench.

parts.name: Fold-Flat Bench
parts.blurb: Folds down to a flat load floor when there is cargo to carry.

parts.name: Cargo Rack
parts.blurb: A steel frame and straps where the back seat was. Lots of room, nowhere to sit.

parts.name: Small Sport Wheel
parts.blurb: A small suede rim with a quick feel. A touch more lock.

parts.name: Chain-Wrapped Wheel
parts.blurb: Chain wound round the rim for grip. Rattles like a bag of spanners.

parts.name: Cracked Dash
parts.blurb: Sun-split plastic and a taped-over glovebox. Everything still lights up.

parts.name: Gauge-Pod Dash
parts.blurb: Aluminium panel with a pod of race gauges. You can see what the engine wants: a little less fuel burned.
